title: The Echo of New Lagos
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Odile Zhou, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
